function check(){const q=SECTIONS[sec].items[idx];if(q.type==='match'){checkMatch();return}if(!q.opts){chosen=document.getElementById('response').value}if(!chosen.trim())return;currentCorrect=normalize(chosen)===normalize(q.answer);attempts++;if(currentCorrect){if(attempts===1)score++;complete.push({section:SECTIONS[sec].title,question:q.q,correctFirstTime:attempts===1,attempts,skipped:false})}phase='feedback';render()}

// Accessible select-and-connect matching: keyboard, touchpad, mouse and touch all work.
let matchSelected=null,matchPairs={};
function renderMatch(){
 const q=SECTIONS[sec].items[idx];
 let left=q.left.map((v,i)=>`<button type="button" class="matchbtn ${matchSelected===i?'selected':''} ${matchPairs[i]!==undefined?'matched':''}" id="left${i}" onclick="pickLeft(${i})" aria-pressed="${matchSelected===i}">${esc(v)}</button>`).join('');
 let right=q.right.map((v,i)=>`<button type="button" class="matchbtn ${Object.values(matchPairs).includes(i)?'matched':''}" id="right${i}" onclick="pickRight(${i})">${esc(v)}</button>`).join('');
 stage.innerHTML=`<span class="tag">QUESTION · MATCHING</span><h2>Connect the equivalent amounts</h2><div class="hint">Select a card on the LEFT, then the equivalent on the RIGHT. A line appears automatically. Select a new card to change a pair.</div><div class="match" id="matcharea"><div class="matchcol">${left}</div><div class="matchcol">${right}</div><svg id="matchlines" aria-hidden="true"></svg></div><p class="muted" id="matchstatus">${Object.keys(matchPairs).length} of ${q.left.length} pairs connected</p>${button('CHECK MY MATCHES','check()')} ${button('CLEAR LINES','clearMatch()','secondary')}`;
 drawMatches();
}
function pickLeft(i){matchSelected=i;renderMatch()}
function pickRight(i){if(matchSelected===null){document.getElementById('matchstatus').textContent='First select a card on the left.';return}for(let key of Object.keys(matchPairs)){if(matchPairs[key]===i)delete matchPairs[key]}matchPairs[matchSelected]=i;matchSelected=null;renderMatch()}
function clearMatch(){matchSelected=null;matchPairs={};renderMatch()}
function drawMatches(){
 const area=document.getElementById('matcharea');const svg=document.getElementById('matchlines');if(!area||!svg)return;
 const box=area.getBoundingClientRect();svg.setAttribute('viewBox',`0 0 ${box.width} ${box.height}`);
 svg.innerHTML=Object.entries(matchPairs).map(([l,r])=>{
 const a=document.getElementById('left'+l).getBoundingClientRect(),b=document.getElementById('right'+r).getBoundingClientRect();
 const x1=a.right-box.left,y1=a.top+a.height/2-box.top,x2=b.left-box.left,y2=b.top+b.height/2-box.top;
 return `<line class="matchline" x1="${x1}" y1="${y1}" x2="${x2}" y2="${y2}"></line>`}).join('');
}
window.addEventListener('resize',drawMatches);
function checkMatch(){
 const q=SECTIONS[sec].items[idx];if(Object.keys(matchPairs).length!==q.left.length){document.getElementById('matchstatus').textContent='Connect every pair before checking.';return}
 currentCorrect=q.pairs.every((v,i)=>matchPairs[i]===v);attempts++;
 if(currentCorrect){if(attempts===1)score++;complete.push({section:SECTIONS[sec].title,question:q.q,correctFirstTime:attempts===1,attempts,skipped:false})}
 phase='feedback';render();
}
